name: Harvey
tagline: Domain-specific AI platform built for elite law firms, corporate legal teams, and private equity.
definition: Harvey is a domain-specific generative AI platform engineered for elite law firms and corporate legal departments. Built on fine-tuned LLMs backed by the OpenAI Startup Fund, it assists attorneys with contract analysis, due diligence, regulatory compliance, and legal brief drafting.
why_it_matters: Harvey became a landmark application of LLMs in professional legal services, earning adoption from major law firms (Allen & Overy) and accounting networks (PwC) to automate complex legal document analysis securely.
workplace_use_cases: Analyzing thousands of merger and acquisition (M&A) due diligence contract agreements
Drafting legal briefs, motions, and memorandum memos with custom jurisdiction parameters
Extracting specific indemnity and liability clauses from complex corporate contracts
Reviewing cross-border regulatory compliance documentation
how_to_use: Access Harvey via secure enterprise SSO portal or Microsoft Word plugin, upload legal contract bundles, and prompt the system for clause comparison or brief drafting.
key_features: Domain-specific legal models fine-tuned on legal doctrine and court filings
Enterprise security architecture (SOC 2 Type II, zero model training on customer data)
Contract clause extraction and automated redlining suggestions
Seamless integration with Microsoft Word and enterprise document management systems

pricing.free_tier_details: No free tier; available via enterprise firm-wide contracts.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise Firm Contract
paid_plans.notes: Custom pricing calculated per law firm seat count and security deployment requirements.

name: CoCounsel
tagline: AI legal assistant powered by GPT-4 for reliable legal research, document review, and deposition prep.
definition: CoCounsel is an AI legal assistant developed by Casetext (acquired by Thomson Reuters). Powered by GPT-4 and grounded in Casetext's verified primary law database, it performs legal research, reviews discovery documents, and prepares deposition outlines.
why_it_matters: CoCounsel resolved LLM hallucination risks in legal research by grounding GPT-4 answers strictly in Casetext's verified database of statutes, case law, and regulations with real citations.
workplace_use_cases: Searching millions of case law precedents to answer complex legal research questions
Extracting critical facts and contradictions across thousands of discovery documents
Drafting comprehensive deposition outlines aligned with witness testimony statements
Summarizing lengthy legal contracts and highlighting non-standard terms
how_to_use: Sign in at Casetext/CoCounsel, select a legal skill (e.g., 'Search Database', 'Review Documents'), input case details or upload files, and review cited research outputs.
key_features: Grounded in Casetext/Thomson Reuters verified primary law database
Legal skills framework (Legal Research, Contract Review, Deposition Prep)
Strict data privacy protection (bank-grade encryption, zero model training)
Inline links to official judicial case law PDFs and court records

pricing.free_tier_details: Free demo available for verified legal professionals.

paid_plans.name: CoCounsel Professional
paid_plans.notes: Custom quotes per firm size and Westlaw/Casetext database access package.

name: Bloomberg Terminal AI
tagline: Financial intelligence and analytics AI integrated into the Bloomberg Terminal.
definition: Bloomberg Terminal AI is the domain-specific financial intelligence suite integrated into the Bloomberg Terminal, analyzing SEC filings, earnings call transcripts, and market news.
why_it_matters: Bloomberg provides the world's most trusted financial data ecosystem, combining financial market databases with fine-tuned LLMs.
workplace_use_cases: Analyzing SEC 10-K and 10-Q filing notes for financial risk factors
Summarizing corporate earnings call transcripts in real time
Extracting financial market sentiment trends across global news wires
how_to_use: Access via Bloomberg Terminal software commands (e.g. `{TOP AI <GO>}`).
key_features: Domain-specific financial model trained on decades of Bloomberg data
Real-time market news and earnings call transcription analysis
Direct integration with Bloomberg market pricing feeds

paid_plans.name: Bloomberg Terminal
paid_plans.notes: Standard annual Bloomberg Terminal subscription fee.

name: Spellbook
tagline: AI contract drafting and review assistant embedded directly in Microsoft Word.
definition: Spellbook is an AI legal assistant that operates directly inside Microsoft Word. Powered by GPT-4, it reviews contracts, suggests missing clauses, and drafts negotiation redlines in real time.
why_it_matters: Spellbook operates directly inside Microsoft Word where lawyers actually work, accelerating contract turnaround times.
workplace_use_cases: Reviewing commercial contracts and identifying missing protective clauses
Suggesting redline edits during contract negotiations directly in Word
Drafting custom agreement clauses based on deal terms
how_to_use: Install the Spellbook add-in in Microsoft Word, open a contract document, and click 'Review Contract'.
key_features: Microsoft Word native add-in interface
Automated contract clause review and redline suggestions
Trained on legal contract doctrine and commercial precedent

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Includes full Word add-in, contract review, and clause drafting.

name: Kavout
tagline: AI investment intelligence platform providing quantitative stock ranking and equity portfolio analysis.
definition: Kavout is an AI financial technology platform that uses machine learning (K Score) to analyze market data, financial statements, and price momentum to rank stocks and assist portfolio managers.
why_it_matters: Kavout brings quantitative machine learning equity ranking models to financial advisors and individual investors.
workplace_use_cases: Screening US stock equities based on AI K Score factor ratings
Analyzing corporate financial health indicators and earnings quality
Constructing quantitative equity model portfolios
how_to_use: Sign in at kavout.com, enter stock tickers to view K Score predictive ratings, or run stock screeners.
key_features: K Score equity rating model (1-9 predictive rating)
Automated stock screener and fundamental data analysis
Portfolio risk management analytics

pricing.free_tier_details: Free plan includes basic stock search and K Scores.

paid_plans.name: Pro
paid_plans.notes: Advanced stock screener, real-time AI market signals.

name: Robin AI
tagline: Legal AI platform for contract copilot editing and legal repository management.
definition: Robin AI is a legal AI platform that combines LLMs with human legal expert review to accelerate contract drafting, negotiation, and repository management.
why_it_matters: Robin AI pairs generative AI contract review with an optional human-in-the-loop legal team for total accuracy.
workplace_use_cases: Accelerating commercial contract review against company playbook rules
Searching across corporate contract repositories for expiration dates
Redlining non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) automatically
how_to_use: Upload contracts to robinai.com or open the MS Word add-in to review against your legal playbook.
key_features: Contract Copilot for inline Word redlining
Legal playbook enforcement engine
Optional human legal expert review add-on

pricing.free_tier_details: Custom quotes based on contract review volume.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise Legal
paid_plans.notes: Priced per user seat and contract processing volume.

name: Doximity GPT
tagline: HIPAA-compliant AI medical writing assistant for physicians and healthcare professionals.
definition: Doximity GPT is a HIPAA-compliant AI medical writing assistant integrated into Doximity's physician network. It assists doctors with drafting patient insurance appeal letters, clinical summaries, and medical documentation.
why_it_matters: Doximity provided verified US doctors with a secure, HIPAA-compliant AI writing environment tailored to clinical workflows.
workplace_use_cases: Drafting insurance prior authorization appeal letters for patient treatments
Writing clinical patient visit summary letters in plain language
Translating medical instructions for patients
how_to_use: Access Doximity GPT via verified Doximity physician account, select a clinical template, and input patient details.
key_features: HIPAA-compliant secure medical writing environment
Pre-built templates for prior authorization letters and appeal notes
Integration with Doximity physician network platform

pricing.free_tier_details: Free for verified US medical professionals on Doximity network.

name: Finquery AI
tagline: Financial accounting AI platform for lease, contract, and balance sheet compliance.
definition: Finquery AI is a financial accounting compliance platform that uses AI to parse corporate lease agreements, contracts, and financial documents to ensure ASC 842 and IFRS 16 compliance.
why_it_matters: Finquery automates complex corporate accounting compliance and balance sheet audit tracking.
workplace_use_cases: Extracting lease payment schedules and audit terms from corporate contracts
Ensuring balance sheet compliance with ASC 842 accounting standards
Auditing vendor contract financial commitments
how_to_use: Upload corporate lease documents to Finquery, and the AI extracts financial schedule parameters.
key_features: Automated contract schedule extraction for lease accounting
ASC 842 and IFRS 16 compliance reporting
Audit trail documentation tracking

pricing.free_tier_details: Custom corporate quotes based on contract volume.

paid_plans.name: Enterprise Accounting
paid_plans.notes: Calculated based on lease contract volume and accounting scope.

name: Casetext
tagline: AI legal research database providing CARA AI document analysis and case law search.
definition: Casetext is an AI-powered legal research platform that analyzes litigation briefs and retrieves relevant judicial case law precedents using CARA AI.
why_it_matters: Casetext pioneered AI litigation research, matching uploaded legal briefs directly to supporting judicial precedents.
workplace_use_cases: Uploading opposing counsel litigation briefs to automatically find counter-precedents
Searching judicial statutes and case law across federal and state jurisdictions
Validating case law citation accuracy
how_to_use: Sign in at casetext.com, upload a brief to CARA AI, and review suggested case law citations.
key_features: CARA AI document-based legal research engine
Comprehensive US federal and state primary law database
Judicial citation analysis and case law summaries

paid_plans.name: Basic Research
paid_plans.notes: Includes primary law search and appellate briefs.

paid_plans.name: Advanced Research
paid_plans.notes: Includes CARA AI brief analyzer and expert witness data.
